name: ai-ui-performance
description: Reversible Windows CPU priority profiles and resource checks for AI desktop and shared browser UIs.

interface.longDescription: Check resource pressure and apply or restore CPU scheduling profiles for verified Windows Codex, Claude Desktop and Cursor installations. Gemini, Grok and browser AI UIs use an explicit shared Chrome/Edge/Brave profile that also affects unrelated tabs. Runs on demand with no background service or telemetry. Does not reduce RAM, change app UI code, or speed cloud inference. Windows only; no measured latency improvement is claimed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-ui-performance to check my AI app UIs and optimize desktop responsiveness.

publication.release_notes: 0.2.0 adds verified desktop AI UI support and explicit shared browser profiles with scoped restore and legacy Codex compatibility.
